testRun.output: All green post-merge. Four previews render. Agent rendered all four compositions at 1240x820 to PNG against comp 02: toolbar inset, stage texture, panel tabs, status bar and the no-panel branch all match. The no-panel render shows neither hairline nor panel, confirming AC-31 visually as well as by code.

implementation.summary: THE DELIVERABLE'S PUBLIC API. Column(fillMaxSize, Theme.color.bg)[toolbar(), Row(weight 1f)[StageSurface(weight 1f, content=stage), if (sidePanel != null) { PanelResizeHandle; SidePanelFrame(width=state.panelWidth) }], statusBar()]. sidePanel is a NULLABLE SLOT TYPE, so a caller cannot express 'panel with no content' - the AC-31 hidden-until-session rule is a compositional branch, not a visibility flag. Handle wired onDelta={state.resizePanelBy(-it)} (handle sits on the panel's leading edge), onDragStopped={state.onDragStopped()?.let(onPanelWidthCommit)} - the shell itself persists NOTHING, matching the drag-end-only decision. Four previews: no-panel/with-panel x Light/Dark.

reusedFromRegistry.how: State, tabs and geometry reused as-is; nothing re-declared

troubleshooting.issue: The dashed phone outline and 'NO SIGNAL' copy live as a PRIVATE preview-only composable, not shipped stage content. T-4's backlog outOfScope explicitly assigns that copy downstream, and StageSurface's plan contract has a required non-defaulted content slot. The visual is verified by render but is not public API. Orchestrator confirmed both ink3 text uses are inside private preview composables, so the ink2-for-authored-text gate decision is not violated.
